values.note: The 32-site family campground is first come, first served: 'We currently do not accept reservations at the family campground, but you may use Scan & Pay through the recreation.gov app to pay for a first come-first served campsite'; there is also a self-service pay station at the entrance. Only the separate two-site group campground is reserved, on recreation.gov.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/elizabeth-furnace-recreation-area (Reservations; Fee Site and Info) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10158475 (Scan & Pay listing, self-service pay station), read 2026-10-20

values.note: $20 a site per night in summer when the water systems run (May-October), $10 in winter with limited services. Paid at the self-service station or by Scan & Pay.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/elizabeth-furnace-recreation-area ('Single Site: $10 per night per non-peak season | Single Site: $20 per night per peak season') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10158475 ('$10/night with limited services and $20/night when water systems are running (May-October)'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Open year-round with limited amenities in winter: flush toilets, showers and hydrant water May to October; vault toilets and a hand pump all year.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/elizabeth-furnace-recreation-area (Seasons of Use: 'Campground and Day Use open year-round with limited amenities during the winter months'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Flush toilets, showers and hydrant water May-October only; vault toilets and a hand pump year-round. No firewood sold.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/elizabeth-furnace-recreation-area (Facility and Amenity Information) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10158475 (amenities list incl. Dump Station; 'No Firewood available'), read 2026-10-20

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/elizabeth-furnace-recreation-area ('Elizabeth Furnace Campground with 32 sites, first come, first served'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed FCFS / not reservable (was derived from note prose), $10 winter / $20 summer. Added year-round season with summer-only showers/flush toilets/hydrants, vault toilets, potable water, dump station, 32 sites. Not stated: hookups, site lengths, max stay; the page says ATB passes are accepted but not that they discount camping, so discounts left inherited.
